faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Kalyani University Coach recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Kalyani University Coach posts is 07 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Coach posts at Kalyani University?
faq.answer: Kalyani University is recruiting for a total of 13 Coach posts across various sports disciplines. The detailed breakdown of vacancies per sport is available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Kalyani University Coach recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the Coach posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Coach posts at Kalyani University. The application is free of cost.
